name: Clara González Pimienta — a daughter Zulema de Jesús born November 1897, Pichilemu, Colchagua, Chile
researcher_question: Clara González Pimienta, born 31 July 1867 at Pumanque, Colchagua, married Benjamín Silva Díaz about 1894, and two sons are known: Saúl Antonio (born 18 September 1894) and Manuel Jesús (born 27 December 1895), both registered in Colchagua. What other children did Clara and Benjamín have?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 5, hint-samples.csv row 170, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved as a true match: the 1897 civil birth registration of Zulema de Jesus Silva Gonzalez at Aguada de San Antonio, Colchagua, confirmed by reading the original image (ark:/61903/3:1:939K-PNQ3-4); parents named as Benjamín Silva y Díaz and Clara González y Pimienta de Silva.
